titulo.en: Berlin Pride attack sparks fresh questions over EU intelligence sharing

sintesis.es: Las autoridades continúan las labores de búsqueda del sospechoso que embistión con un vehículo a una multitud de gente, dejando un muerto y al menos 29 heridos. Según el ministro del Interior de Alemania, todo indica que fue "un ataque terrorista islamista".
sintesis.en: The Berlin Pride attack has reignited debate over whether intelligence sharing between EU member states is sufficient. The attacker was known to German authorities and had travelled to Turkey looking to enter Syria.

titulo.es: Tercera noche sin ataques entre EE.UU. e Irán: cae precio del petróleo y Ormuz sigue cerrado
titulo.en: Oman presents Iran with Gulf-backed plan to ease Strait of Hormuz tensions

sintesis.es: Este lunes 27 de julio, Irán informó que suspendió sus ataques. Estados Unidos lo hizo el fin semana. Con ello, ambos países dieron un respiro a la navegación y a la industria petrolera en el Golfo, aunque en el estrecho de Ormuz fueron detenidos seis buques.
sintesis.en: Oman has presented Iran with a Gulf-backed proposal to jointly manage the Strait of Hormuz, including a system of voluntary fees for ships using the strategic waterway, according to a Gulf source and a Western diplomat. The plan aims to provide a framework for restoring stable shipping through the strait after months of disruption caused by the US-Israeli war on Iran and further attacks on commercial vessels.

sintesis.es: La iniciativa de Gianni Infantino de crear una filial comercial de la FIFA para vender acciones de la Copa del Mundo, reportada por el diario inglés The Times, chocó con el rechazo de la entidad rectora del balompié en Europa, la UEFA, que ha apuntado que “ha expresado dudas en torno a “la transparencia sobre quién gana económicamente”.
sintesis.en: FIFA President Gianni Infantino’s plan to create a $20 billion company running the World Cup with private investors including the Kushner family was announced Tuesday — and immediately attacked by European soccer body UEFA. “It is not FIFA’s to sell,” UEFA said in a statement. “None of us are the owners of football.” FRANCE 24's James Vasina reports.

titulo.es: Terremoto de magnitud 7,1 en Japón deja al menos 13 muertos y decenas de desaparecidos
titulo.en: Magnitude 7.1 earthquake in Japan leaves at least 13 dead and dozens missing

sintesis.es: Un fuerte terremoto de magnitud 7,1 sacudió la región de Kumamoto, en el suroeste de Japón, dejando al menos 13 muertos. Cerca de 20 personas continúan desaparecidas, la mitad de ellas atrapadas en un centro comercial donde se produjo una explosión tras el sismo. Las autoridades japonesas mantienen labores de búsqueda y rescate en la zona.
sintesis.en: A powerful magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck the Kumamoto region in southwestern Japan, leaving at least 13 people dead. Around 20 people remain missing, half of them trapped in a shopping mall where an explosion occurred following the quake. Japanese authorities continue search and rescue operations in the area.

titulo.en: FCC bans humanoid robots from China, citing ‘unacceptable risks’

sintesis.es: Move comes as the Trump administration has increasingly sought to keep Chinese technology out of the US The Federal Communications Commission announced a ban on humanoid robots from China on Tuesday, saying that the technology poses “unacceptable risks” to the country’s national security. The move comes as the Trump administration has increasingly sought to keep Chinese technology out of the US. The FCC defines the banned robots as “advanced robotic devices”, which include humanoids and animal-like quadrupeds.

titulo.es: New quantum gravity theory links entropy, dark energy, and life
titulo.en: New quantum gravity theory links entropy, dark energy, and life

sintesis.es: A new theoretical study offers a possible explanation for how the Universe can grow more complex without violating the second law of thermodynamics. Using a quantum gravity framework called Gravity from Entropy, mathematician Ginestra Bianconi found that the Universe’s total entropy may rise as space expands, even while entropy within each unit of volume falls. That decline could leave room for galaxies, stars, planets, and life to form locally amid an overall increase in cosmic entropy.
